instruction: Open the email attachment from Notes folder and save the Word document to your home directory.

result.command: bash -c 'if [ -f /home/user/lecture-notes.docx ]; then echo "exists"; file -b --mime-type /home/user/lecture-notes.docx; stat -c "%Y" /home/user/lecture-notes.docx; else echo "missing"; fi'

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening Thunderbird email in Notes and saving Word attachment to home directory. Evaluator verifies: (1) file exists at /home/user/lecture-notes.docx, (2) file is a valid Word document (MIME type check), (3) file was created during task execution (timestamp check). Note: The filename 'lecture-notes.docx' is determined by the Thunderbird profile setup. Complete verification of email opening from Notes folder is not feasible in OSWorld environment; file verification serves as acceptable proxy.
metadata.verification: Verified evaluator checks file existence, type (Word document), and creation timestamp
metadata.filename_assumption: The attachment filename 'lecture-notes.docx' comes from the Thunderbird profile setup included in the task configuration

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies file saving requirement with proper checks: file existence, MIME type validation, and timestamp verification
Metric function properly handles expected parameter (uses expected.get('task_start_time') correctly for type='rule')

Timestamp check prevents false positives from pre-existing files by verifying file was created after task started

Filename assumption ('lecture-notes.docx') is documented in metadata and comes from Thunderbird profile setup
